message: Dependabot proposes cargo updates after 3 days (Dependabot's default (3 days)), but Cargo waits 1 week (registry.global-min-publish-age: "1 week" in .cargo/config.toml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Cargo picks itself, and Cargo keeps them, as it keeps the versions in Cargo.lock
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 1 week, or run depcurfew apply

message: Dependabot proposes gomod updates after 1 day (semver-major-days: 1 in .github/dependabot.yml), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 1 week, which covers Go dependencies, and Go has no release-age delay of its own; its pull requests bring in versions younger than that
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 1 week, or run depcurfew apply

message: Dependabot proposes nuget updates of dependencies that cooldown.include does not name without waiting (cooldown.include in .github/dependabot.yml names only Contoso.*), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 1 week, which covers NuGet dependencies, and NuGet has no release-age delay for what a restore takes (minPublishAgeHours holds back only the versions that dotnet package add and dotnet package update choose, from .NET SDK 11.0.100 on); its pull requests bring in versions younger than that
fix: Remove include from the cooldown of updates[3] in .github/dependabot.yml, so that the cooldown covers every dependency, and list exceptions under exclude instead
